items.title: Surge Engine: everything in the app
items.body: A full tour of every feature, tab by tab.

changes.text: Dashboard: Auto clicker with any key or mouse button as the activation key, including Middle, Mouse 4, Mouse 5 and Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win combos.
Dashboard: Hold mode clicks only while the key is down. Toggle mode starts on one press and stops on the next.
Dashboard: Left, middle or right mouse button clicks.
Dashboard: Click speed from 0.1 up to 500 clicks per second, or unlimited, with an adjustable click duty cycle and a live click / wait timing readout.
Dashboard: Click limit to stop automatically after a set number of clicks.
Dashboard: Click position: at the cursor, or at a fixed screen position you capture with a 3 second countdown.
Dashboard: Choose apps: only click while one of your checked programs is in the foreground.
Dashboard: Total click counter and a READY / CLICKING status pill.
Dashboard: Right now card showing the Roblox game you are currently in.
Dashboard: Autostart with Windows, always on top, reset settings, and everything saves automatically.
Dashboard: Languages: English, Deutsch and Español.
Dashboard: High precision click timing for steady, consistent speeds.
Dashboard: Guided tour of the important parts, which you can replay any time.
Profile: Discord profile card with an option to show your status on Discord.
Profile: Themes: Default black, Surge official, Floating Stars, Snowfall, Embers, Rain, Solo Leveling x Qc1m, Sasuke Sunset and Frosted Glass.
Profile: Import your own picture, GIF or video as a custom theme, with optional looping background music and a volume slider.
Profile: Accent colour picker and an option to keep theme animations running when the window is not focused.
Profile: Streamproof: hides the app from screen sharing, streams and recordings, with its own hotkey to toggle it from anywhere.
Profile: Open settings folder shortcut.
Roblox: FPS cap unlocker plus quick toggles for low-res textures, shadows, post-processing, anti-aliasing and the renderer.
Roblox: FFlag editor and one-click reset for your fast flags.
Roblox: Custom fonts: add your own font file, open the fonts folder, and restore the original any time.
Roblox: Launch Roblox straight from the app (with a Game ID or direct), open the Roblox folder, and clear cache and logs.
Movement: Snappy Tappy: when you hold two opposite keys, the last one pressed wins, with separate Left / Right and Forward / Back switches.
Movement: Rebind each movement key by clicking a slot, or by clicking it on the on-screen keyboard.
Clips: Instant Replay that keeps the last moments of your game ready to save with a hotkey.
Clips: Manual recording with its own hotkey, plus audio and hotkey settings (PC audio and microphone).
Clips: Overlays: webcam in your recordings (mirror option), keyboard overlay, mouse overlay and a mic indicator that lights up when you talk.
Clips: Library of your saved clips with preview, storage settings and a built-in FFmpeg download.
Utilities: Screen tools: software brightness, gamma and warmth, for one or all monitors, with restore on exit and apply on start.
Utilities: Internet tools: DNS and QoS (DSCP) settings.
Utilities: Game Mode with boost, calm, memory, power and timer options for smoother gaming.
Shake: Mouse shake with left / right or up / down direction, adjustable speed, amount, ramp-up, randomness and an auto stop timer.
Shake: Its own hold / toggle key, separate from the clicker.
Crosshair: Custom cursors for Roblox: import your own images, preview them and pick a size.
Crosshair: Keeps your cursor and font after Roblox updates, backs up the originals so Restore always works, and supports Roblox, Bloxstrap and Fishstrap.
Macros: Record, edit and play back macros, with a panic key (F12 by default) that stops everything instantly.
Presets: Save, share and apply your whole setup in one click.
Games: Click a game to jump straight in.
Extras: Daily spin wheel: one free spin every 24 hours, with the countdown shown in the sidebar.
Extras: Login with your Discord account. It remembers you, follows your theme, and keeps its frosted look on Frosted Glass.
Extras: News and patch notes panel that updates live while the app is open.
